gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Kasa outdoor plug (EP40) works only on a 2.4 GHz secured Wi-Fi network, has a 15 A / 1,875 W limit shared by both outlets, and must be plugged into a GFCI receptacle when used outdoors or in wet locations. Those are the limits an RV owner hits when using it on an exterior RV outlet or on a campground or hotspot network.
standout_why: ChatGPT recommended a 'Kasa Outdoor Smart Plug' card ($23.49), but none of its 12 + 17 results is a Kasa or TP-Link page. All of them cover RV surge protectors (Hughes, Power Watchdog, Southwire, United RV Parts, RV Upgrade Store, Walmart category pages). The cited RV Upgrade Store PWD30EPOW page says nothing about the Wi-Fi band, and I read it in full. I could not open the cited powerwatchdog.com/shop page or any other powerwatchdog.com page (a certificate error each time), so I could not check whether those pages state the Gen II's Wi-Fi band. The Kasa limits are new because no result covers the plug ChatGPT recommended. They don't decide the pick because the shopper still has to choose between whole-RV shore-power protection and controlling single appliances.
decides: This confirms ChatGPT's split between the two jobs and adds limits for the appliance side. Kasa EP40: the shopper needs a 2.4 GHz network (not 5 GHz-only), a GFCI outlet (on an RV exterior outlet or campground pedestal), and loads that total no more than 15 A / 1,875 W across both outlets. That rules it out for an RV air conditioner or a space heater plus another load. For the shore-power side, the Hughes PWD30EPOW connects to a 30 A pedestal (30 A, 3,600 W max). It uses the Power WatchDog app, over Bluetooth on site and Wi-Fi remotely, and Camping World lists it as compatible with RV Whisper. A 50 A rig needs the 50 A version. The Gen II's own Wi-Fi band requirement remains unsourced. The Minoston MP22Z, which Dealectric lists, needs a Z-Wave hub, so it only suits an RV with a Z-Wave controller already on board. I could not confirm the hub requirement from Minoston's own page.
